facts.text: Niagara University is one of only three Vincentian institutions of higher education in the United States, alongside St. John's University and DePaul University.

sources.title: President Emeritus, The Rev. Joseph L. Levesque, C.M., passes away - NU News
sources.quote: Niagara and St. John's universities, two of the three Vincentian institutions of higher education in the United States (DePaul University is the other).
